# Application chart instructions

These rules apply to application charts in `charts/stable/<chart>/` and `charts/incubator/<chart>/`. They add to the general rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md). Read the area file before editing:

| Paths | Read |
| --- | --- |
| `values.yaml`, `ci/**` | [`charts-values.instructions.md`](charts-values.instructions.md) |
| `templates/**` | [`charts-templates.instructions.md`](charts-templates.instructions.md) |

## Chart layout

```text
charts/stable/<chart>/
├── Chart.yaml            # bump `version` for every non-docs change (PRs into master only)
├── values.yaml           # chart configuration; only overrides of `common` defaults
├── templates/
│   ├── common.yaml       # {{ include "tc.v1.common.loader.all" . }}
│   ├── NOTES.txt         # {{- include "tc.v1.common.lib.chart.notes" $ -}}
│   └── _<name>.tpl       # optional, chart-specific helpers only
├── ci/*-values.yaml      # optional, install-test values (CI runs one install per file)
├── docs/*.md             # optional, user docs (frontmatter `title:`); no version bump needed
├── README.md             # GENERATED: do not edit
├── CHANGELOG.md          # GENERATED: do not edit
├── .helmignore           # GENERATED: do not edit
└── icon.webp, icon-small.webp  # GENERATED by the daily workflow from an icon.<ext> (e.g. icon.png)
```

Charts are thin wrappers around the `common` library. Express everything through values that `common` understands, such as `workload`, `service`, `persistence`, `configmap`, `secret`, `ingress`, `dependencies`, `metrics` and `addons`. The library documentation is at <https://trueforge.org/truecharts-common>, with the sources in `charts/library/common/docs/`.

Use `charts/stable/app-template` as the reference for the file structure of a new chart, and leave out what the new chart does not need.

## `Chart.yaml`

- Bump `version` following the SemVer table in `AGENTS.md`. Renamed or removed keys, ports or persistence paths are **major**.
- `common`, from `oci://oci.trueforge.org/truecharts`, is the only dependency. Keep the full dependency block format used by existing charts (`condition`, `alias`, `tags` and `import-values` keys present).
  - Do not add subcharts such as `valkey`, `redis` or `mariadb`; use `dependencies.<name>` in `values.yaml`.
  - Never use `file://` dependencies in app charts.
  - Do not bump the `common` version by hand unless the task needs a feature from a newer `common`.
- Adding a new chart: set the `description`, `keywords`, `type: application`, `version` and a `trueforge.org/category` annotation. Copy the remaining fields from an existing chart, and add an `icon.png` (or other `icon.<ext>`) for the daily workflow to convert.

## Tests (`ci/`)

- CI installs each changed chart in a k3d cluster with `ct install`, once per `ci/*-values.yaml` file, or with the default values if there are none. If a chart has a `test-chart/` subdirectory, CI installs that wrapper chart instead.
- Add or update a `ci/*-values.yaml` file when a change can't be exercised with the defaults (e.g. optional features, alternative databases).
- Charts that cannot run in CI (game servers, hardware-dependent apps, etc.) are listed in `.github/ct-install.yaml` `excluded-charts`. Do not add charts there just to make CI pass.

## Docs

User-facing docs go in `charts/<train>/<chart>/docs/*.md`, each with frontmatter with a `title:`. Changes that only touch `docs/` do not need a version bump.

## Validate locally

Run from the repository root, using the latest Helm 4 (see `AGENTS.md` → Toolchain):

```bash
chart=charts/stable/<chart>

helm dependency build "$chart"      # retry if oci.trueforge.org returns "unexpected EOF"
helm lint --strict "$chart"
helm template test "$chart" >/dev/null
for f in "$chart"/ci/*values.yaml; do [ -f "$f" ] && helm template test "$chart" -f "$f" >/dev/null; done

# CI lint: helm lint, Chart.yaml schema, yamllint and the version-bump check against master
git fetch origin master
result_file=/tmp/lint_result.txt .github/scripts/tc-lint.sh "[\"$chart\"]" origin/master

pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only origin/master -- "$chart")

# Validate values.yaml against the common values schema, like CI does for every chart
tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && ln -s "$PWD/$chart" "$tmp/"
python3 charts/library/common/test_schema.py --stable-dir "$tmp" --common-test-ci-dir "$tmp" --output-file "$tmp/schema.log"
rm -rf "$tmp"

rm -rf "$chart/charts" "$chart/Chart.lock"   # never commit these
```

`tc-lint.sh` needs `helm`, `yamllint`, `yamale`, GNU `parallel` and `jq`. When a key is valid for `common` but fails the schema check, the schema needs fixing in `charts/library/common`; mention it rather than removing the key.
